scope: new methods-only intervention validation lane; not fourth EOG-WF endpoint; no outcome access or scoring in this gate; prior McKee STOP and frozen 3/31/3 unchanged
question: Can a fixed before-intervention source set and independent directed river network/barrier intervention schedule constrain later fish recolonization without treating non-detections as absence or tuning to post-intervention records?

queries: dam removal fish recolonization before after site survey data repository river barrier removal fish presence USGS Dryad
river dam removal fish community upstream downstream before after monitoring dataset data release sampling sites dates fish passage
search.budget: one search batch of two queries; screen up to first five distinct primary study/data families in returned order per query, deduplicate, preserve observed order and rejected families; no iterative outcome-based candidate hunting
search.qualification: public study abstracts may expose aggregate findings, log exposure; no claim of blinded literature results; do not open individual post-intervention response rows

required: stable public dataset identity and documented provenance; checksums or versioned content before data analysis
survey site/reach registry, dates and taxon-specific detection or standardized effort before and after intervention; pre/post separable
documented barrier locations and removal dates independent of post-intervention fish observations
directed river connectivity and source registry available or prospectively reconstructible without post-intervention outcomes
independent pre-response transition parameter basis or conservative declared world set; no fitting on heldout post-removal observations
explicit source/response firewall and no unsupported absence inference
ranking: first dataset family in discovery order with documented metadata for all first four requirements and feasible independent world declaration; if none fully qualifies, retain first plausible candidate with outstanding gates; no response release
output: source roster with eligibility and blockers; candidate gate contract; no effect size, EOG score, field claim, or data download during metadata phase
stop: if source access or pre/post/directed geography semantics unresolved, STOP before scoring. No candidate replacement after response exposure. Any cost units hypothetical unless documented; intervention is conditional connectivity change, not regeneration or causal efficacy.
